page: Microsoft Azure D16pds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on the arm64 architecture. It is powered by Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processors operating at 3.4 GHz, providing 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs with a single thread per core. The processor subsystem includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 128 MB of shared L3 cache. Memory is configured at 64.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes a bundled 945 GB local NVMe solid-state drive for scratch and temporary storage, and it supports Premium Storage volumes.

Benchmark results highlight strong memory subsystem efficiency and throughput. The instance achieves a top-decile PassMark memory score of 3241.27, backed by large-block uncached read speeds of 312.21 GB/sec and write speeds of 125.75 GB/sec, placing it in the top quartile of measured hardware. Single-threaded gzip compression performance is similarly strong at 32.98 GB/sec. General compute benchmarks reflect standard mid-range behavior, recording a PassMark CPU score of 14758.63, a Geekbench single-core score of 1683.0, and a multi-core score of 14755.0. Redis SET operations reach 32.55 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput measures 28.04 GB/sec.

The absence of dedicated graphics hardware and slower prompt processing throughput on medium 7B language models make this server less suited for large generative model inferencing. However, the balance of dedicated ARM cores, high uncached memory bandwidth, and direct-attached NVMe storage delivers high resource density. Microsoft Azure D16pds_v6 is technically suited for static and dynamic web serving, relational and key-value database operations, software build systems, and general business enterprise workloads requiring local scratch disk performance.
description: Microsoft Azure D16pds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by 16 dedicated physical cores of the arm64 Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz. It provides 64.0 GB of system memory, matching a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, along with a bundled 945 GB local NVMe SSD for fast transient storage. Benchmark data demonstrates top-tier memory performance, achieving an uncached large-block read speed of 312.21 GB/sec, write bandwidth of 125.75 GB/sec, and a top-decile PassMark memory score. Compute metrics sit within median expectations, supported by 128 MB of L3 cache and hardware AES encryption. While lacking hardware acceleration for complex machine learning tasks, the dense architecture and included NVMe drive make it an efficient fit for web serving, caching tiers, software compilation, and transactional database workloads.
og_description: Microsoft Azure D16pds_v6 features 16 arm64 Neoverse-N2 cores, 64 GB RAM, and a bundled 945 GB NVMe SSD. It delivers top-tier memory throughput and balanced compute for database and web workloads.
